totalEvents.description: Total number of events ever recorded across all sessions

totalSessions.description: Total number of sessions ever recorded

activeSessions.description: Number of sessions currently marked is_active = true

avgProcessingLatency.description: Average time in ms from wake-word to command parsed, across all events

avgResponseLatency.description: Average time in ms from command parsed to robot action, across all events

successRate.description: Percentage of events where success = true, expressed as a string to 1 decimal place

byType.description: Event count grouped by event_type. Used for bar chart on dashboard.

latencyOverTime.description: Average processing latency bucketed per minute for the last 60 minutes. Used for line chart.

avg_latency.description: Average processing latency in ms for that minute bucket

count.description: Number of events recorded in that minute

wakeWordStats.description: Wake-word detection outcome split. Used for pie chart on dashboard.

_id.description: true = detected successfully, false = detection failed

count.description: Number of wake-word events with this outcome
